user.title: Sign in to Tile
user.description: Credentials are used once to download tracker keys; the password is not stored. Afterwards the integration works locally, without the cloud.

data_description.battery_enabled: Requires storing Tile credentials and a once-per-24h cloud check - the only part of this integration that is not fully local.
